performance: Exact accepted Chatterbox audition; no resynthesis or audio processing

alignment.method: Local Meta wav2vec2 phoneme-CTC forced alignment of exact Chatterbox WAV and contextual eSpeak script phones; blank gaps bounded and diphthongs subdivided for visemes
alignment.blankPolicy: Gaps <=120 ms split at midpoint; longer blank gaps keep a pause after 40 ms extension per side
alignment.diphthongPolicy: Equal visual subdivisions inside each aligned diphthong interval
alignment.normalization: Internal 24-to-16 kHz polyphase resampling; model-configured zero-mean/unit-variance input; output WAV unchanged
alignment.sentenceCues: Start at next sentence's aligned first word; first cue includes leading silence; final cue includes tail
alignment.limitations: Automatic phoneme acoustic estimates on 20 ms frames; CTC blanks are not silence labels; no manual phonetic annotation
alignment.fallbackReason: MFA Windows installation failed in an unrelated GDK post-install dependency
